worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.summary: Several thick roots rise from real supported entry points around the destination, then sweep inward. Only actual tip contacts strike, once per enemy. Walls stop the arms; exhaustion follows.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.descriptio: Each enemy swept by a root tip takes about %1$s Grass special power; overlapping arms still settle only once.
Root entries spread around a %1$s-block radius, at range up to %2$s. Real support is required, leaving spaces between the arms to evade.
Retraction leaves brief leaf traces while terrain stays intact.
Afterwards the user is spent for %1$s, unable to act or move; with Grip, struck targets are pinned in place and cannot move for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.use.1: Lash several foes packed on one patch
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.use.2: Pin a target in place for a teammate
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.preference: On: the roots spread wider (radius x1.25) and pin struck targets in place for a while, but each hit is lighter and the spent window is longer. Off: tighter roots, higher damage per hit, faster recovery, but nothing is pinned.
How many enemies must be near the landing point before the companion casts. Higher saves it for clusters; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops casting (unless it can cover three or more targets). Higher avoids leaving a spent opening.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.growth.0: From level %1$s root power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.growth.1: From level %1$s root power rises again to %2$s.
